source: Source-informed VPM redesign of the component definition and rendering pipeline. Upstream sources and tests were inspected; this is not a clean-room claim. Public declarations, HTML/SVG shorthand names, compatibility fields and diagnostic wording retain the upstream contract and attribution.
changes: StyleDefinition handles template collection, predicate composition, inheritance and retargeting; one shared renderer handles theme lookup, registered classes, serialization and insertion. Emotion-facing metadata remains an explicit compatibility facade for MUI.

The theme context is read on every render: the original read it only when the theme prop was null, so a component whose theme prop came and went changed the order of its hooks (React warns in development).

On vemotion-is-prop-valid (so current HTML attributes such as command and commandFor reach DOM elements), vemotion-serialize, vemotion-utils and vemotion-use-insertion-effect-with-fallbacks; vemotion-react is a pinned dependency so an install cannot fall back to an unclaimed VPM peer name.
No macro entry, so no run-time dependency on @emotion/babel-plugin or @babel/runtime: 5 direct dependencies instead of 6.
Declarations on React's React.JSX namespace, checked with React 18.3 and 19 types.

verification.upstreamSuite: The complete VPM Emotion stack is checked against the pinned upstream suite. React 16 development: 413 passing, two documented Babel-plugin differences, eight skipped (423 total). React 18 development: 416 passing, the same two differences, five skipped. Production: five passing and 418 skipped. See scripts/emotion-conformance/README.md for the configuration, adaptations and snapshot counts.
verification.regression: hook-order.cjs renders a styled component whose theme prop comes and goes with React 16.14: React reports a change in the order of hooks for the original and nothing for VPM.
verification.declarations: types.cjs compiles a TSX application (shorthands with props, shouldForwardProp, styled components, withComponent, an augmented Theme, and two expected errors) with React 18.3 and 19 types under the configured TypeScript 7 compiler.
verification.application: styled-consumer.cjs compares ten identical HTML/CSS renders against upstream with the installed VentiMath consumer versions: MUI system 7.2.0, styled-engine 7.3.9, React 19.1.0; Node 24 and Bun.
verification.benchmark: bench/compare.cjs: fresh process per implementation, balanced order, identical-source controls; component construction and server rendering with the full corresponding Emotion stack.

implementation.basis: Replaces the former close translation of upstream createStyled with StyleDefinition and a shared rendering/insertion pipeline. Existing hook-order and current-attribute fixes are retained.
implementation.scope: Template and object styles, theme and props, explicit prop predicates, as, targets, labels, inherited styles and withComponent; MUI can replace __emotion_styles before extending a component.
